sources.title: Natnael Tilahun: Potato Leaf (Healthy and Late Blight), version 2
provenance_warnings: Whole-source reserved evaluation: do not use images, embeddings, labels or results for candidate training, calibration or checkpoint selection. Acquisition and duplicate-quality checks only until candidate is frozen.
Publisher reports 63 late blight and 363 healthy photos collected with two plant pathologists. Actual inventory must be verified. Not Nepal validation; no early blight class.
